note: [L] carries the jet action on curvature components and derivatives as YM.Extra.FD.carry / reel (two-form indices via `bi`) and reel_gradient (derivative index), and the induced action R_d^Max on the Maxwell fields as YM.Extra.FD.ride / rideO via pullSol. The difference is the index convention: [L] contracts h's first index (with argument h^{-1}x) where [M] contracts h's first index on the summed side, i.e. the action by h versus its transpose.

snippet.text:
def carry (s : Ortho) : TwoJet F j →ₗ[ℝ] TwoJet F j where
  toFun Q := bi s.val (fun i m => byDir s (Q i m))
  map_add' Q R := by
    change bi s.val _ = _
    rw [← map_add (bi s.val)]
    congr 1
  map_smul' t Q := by
    change bi s.val _ = _
    rw [← map_smul (bi s.val)]
    congr 1

proof_context.conclusion: O(4) acts on two-form (curvature) jets by `bi s.val` on both form indices, (bi s v)_{im} = sum_{a,b} s_{ia} s_{mb} v_{ab}, and by composition with the motion of s^{-1} on the derivative directions.
For the rotated two-form field `reel s f`, the derivative grad_a transforms as a third tensor index: grad_a (reel s f)_{im} = sum s_{iu} s_{mv} s_{ab} grad_b f_{uv} at s^{-1}x.

The rotation action on the free Maxwell fields `(freeTable F).Field d` is induced by `pullSol s` on Wick polynomials (preserving `shellSector`), and `rideO` packages it as a linear equivalence with inverse `ride s⁻¹`.
